function_declarations.name: query_pricing_and_payment_plans
function_declarations.description: Query official 9LMNTS Studio pricing, scope of deliverables, and PayPal Pay Later / Pay in 4 installment payment plans across Agency Sprints, Monthly Retainers, 9LMNTS OS Series, and Live Competition Arenas.

service_category.description: The category of 9LMNTS Studio service to look up.

payment_preference.description: Client's desired payment plan mode handled via PayPal E-Commerce Services.

function_declarations.name: create_paypal_ecommerce_order
function_declarations.description: Creates a verified PayPal E-Commerce order session and payment plan link via the 9LMNTS Studio n8n execution engine.

service_title.description: Name of the sprint, retainer, or competition pass (e.g. 'Starter Sprint', 'Pro Retainer', 'VIP Table & Bottle Service').

payment_plan_type.description: Select 'pay_in_4' for interest-free bi-weekly installments, 'pay_in_full' for standard checkout, or 'monthly_recurring' for retainers.

client_name.description: Client full name or company entity.

client_email.description: Client email address for PayPal order confirmation and invoice delivery.

project_notes.description: Optional notes or requirements for the sprint or live arena.
